decks.notes: This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy by using cards like Thoughtseize, Duress, and Go Blank to control their hand. It also utilizes Waste Not to generate value from discarding cards. Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Sheoldred's Edict help control the board, while cards like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat take care of opposing creatures. The deck also includes a mix of card draw and removal spells, along with a few win conditions like Aclazotz, Deepest Betrayal and Hostile Investigator. Castle Locthwain provides card advantage and mana fixing.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with cards, mainly through draw spells like Opt and Sleight of Hand, in order to bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard and attack aggressively. Additionally, the deck includes counterspells like Spell Pierce and removal spells like Lightning Axe to control the board and protect the Phoenix. The inclusion of Treasure Cruise and Temporal Trespass allows for card advantage and potentially casting multiple spells in a turn. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast, recurring threats while maintaining control of the game.

This deck focuses on quickly casting spells to trigger the recursive ability of Arclight Phoenix, allowing for a high-paced aggressive playstyle. The deck includes cards like Consider, Opt, Sleight of Hand, and Treasure Cruise to draw through the deck quickly and find the Phoenix. With plenty of spell cards and card draw, the deck aims to fill up the graveyard with Phoenixes and bring them back to the battlefield to overwhelm the opponent. The addition of cards like Ledger Shredder and Ashiok, Dream Render helps to disrupt the opponent's strategy and fuel the deck's game plan.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's hand and board through discard spells like Duress and Thoughtseize, removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat, and planeswalkers like Liliana of the Veil. It also aims to generate value from discarding cards with Waste Not and utilizing graveyard recursion with cards like Cling to Dust. The deck has a control strategy with a strong emphasis on resource management and card advantage, using powerful threats like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to close out the game.

The deck focuses on using a combination of creatures and spells to quickly gain life and generate mana, allowing the player to cast powerful spells like Aetherflux Reservoir to deal lethal damage to the opponent. By efficiently tutoring for creatures with Chord of Calling and Collected Company, while also utilizing cards like Wildgrowth Walker and Lunarch Veteran for life gain and resilience, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a well-timed explosive finish. The inclusion of cards like Boseiju, Who Endures and Cenote Scout helps to ensure the success of the combo strategy.

This aggressive Arclight Phoenix deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with instants and sorceries to bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard for repeated attacks. By combining efficient removal spells like Lightning Axe with card draw spells like Consider and Opt, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent early in the game. The inclusion of Treasure Cruise provides additional card advantage to keep the pressure on the opponent. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Spell Pierce and Brazen Borrower to control the board and protect its key threats.

The Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and efficient removal spells. By utilizing cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Venerated Loxodon, the deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early on and finish the game before they have a chance to stabilize. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an extra layer of consistency to the deck. With a low mana curve and powerful creatures, Boros Aggro is designed to win fast and decisively.

The deck focuses on utilizing Niv-Mizzet Reborn as the centerpiece for a control strategy, with a diverse range of multicolored cards to support his ability to draw cards and provide value. The deck includes a variety of removal spells, ramp cards, and support creatures to control the board and maintain card advantage. The addition of Bring to Light allows for additional flexibility in finding key cards, while the inclusion of Yorion as a companion provides extra value through flickering permanents. Overall, the deck aims to control the game and outvalue opponents through Niv-Mizzet Reborn's powerful ability.

The main focus of this deck is to assemble the Amalia Life combo, which involves using cards like Amalia Benavides Aguirre, Chord of Calling, and Collected Company to generate a large amount of life gain. This combo is supported by cards like Aetherflux Reservoir and Prosperous Innkeeper to deal damage to the opponent based on the amount of life gained. Supporting cards like Extraction Specialist, Skyclave Apparition, and Return to the Ranks provide additional utility and protection to ensure the combo can be executed successfully.

The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy through hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Duress, while also controlling the board with removal spells like Fatal Push and Sheoldred's Edict. Waste Not helps generate more value when forcing discards, while cards like Bitter Triumph and Aclazotz provide additional win conditions. The deck also utilizes planeswalkers like Liliana of the Veil for card advantage and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse for a big threat. Utilizing cards like Go Blank and Field of Ruin to disrupt the opponent's hand and mana base, Mono Black Control aims to outvalue and outlast the opponent.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on efficiently disrupting the opponent with hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Duress, while also applying pressure with aggressive creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Preacher of the Schism. The deck also utilizes powerful planeswalkers like Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord to buff creatures and generate advantage. The inclusion of cards like Bitter Triumph and Vein Ripper provide additional disruption and removal options. Overall, the deck aims to control the board and apply constant pressure to overwhelm opponents in a fast-paced aggressive strategy.

This deck focuses on utilizing Niv-Mizzet Reborn as a powerful control engine, with multiple spells and permanents providing card advantage and removal options. The deck aims to stabilize the board early with ramp and removal, then overwhelm the opponent with Niv-Mizzet's ability to draw cards and provide access to a wide range of multicolored spells. The inclusion of cards like Bring to Light, Leyline Binding, and Vanishing Verse allows for versatile answers to a variety of threats, while the companion Yorion, Sky Nomad offers additional value through blinking permanents for extra card advantage and flexibility.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quick and aggressive plays to overwhelm the opponent. Utilizing cards like Vein Ripper, Archfiend of the Dross, and Bloodtithe Harvester, this deck aims to deal damage quickly and efficiently. The deck also includes cards like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. With a mix of creatures, removal spells, and card advantage engines like Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord, this deck aims to win the game before the opponent has a chance to recover.

This deck focuses on utilizing the lifegain synergies of cards like Wildgrowth Walker and Prosperous Innkeeper to create a combo with Amalia Benavides Aguirre. By efficiently ramping up mana and controlling the board with cards like Skyclave Apparition, players can assemble their combo pieces and win the game with cards like Chord of Calling or Aetherflux Reservoir. Returns to the Ranks can help recover key combo pieces from the graveyard, while cards like Lunarch Veteran provide additional support and utility. The deck aims to outvalue opponents and overwhelm them with a powerful combo finish.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Duress while using Waste Not to capitalize on discarded cards. It also aims to control the board with removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat. The deck features powerful creatures like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Hostile Investigator to win the game. It also has various card draw and graveyard interaction tools to outvalue the opponent. The goal is to grind out the game using resource denial and powerful threats to secure victory.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by generating card advantage and manipulating the board state through various spells and creatures. It utilizes powerful control cards like Spelunking, Fading Hope, and Blue Sun's Twilight to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck also seeks to ramp up its mana production with cards like Arboreal Grazer and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx in order to cast game-changing spells like Storm the Festival and Pick Your Poison. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion adds additional value by allowing for exponential card advantage through blinking creatures and permanents.
